Windows related-series end years: fixed the Home 'Related via TMDB; verified using TVDB when available' recommendations and See All series cards showing only the debut year after a series has ended. These cards now use the same exact-TMDB-ID verified series run resolver as Search and Discover; finished/cancelled shows display their confirmed first and last years, while ongoing titles retain the premiere year. Also corrected matching related cards on Details. Movies, origin/language, star ratings, source browsing, gameplay, playback and iOS native behavior remain unchanged.
